modules.name: main
modules.description: Application entry point. Sets version from build flags and delegates to cobra CLI.
modules.interfaces: Calls cmd.SetVersion() and cmd.Execute(). Exit code 1 on error.

modules.name: cmd
modules.description: CLI command layer using Cobra framework. Defines three subcommands: watch (default), scan, and mcp. Handles configuration loading, directory initialization, signal handling, and orchestrates analyzer/mcp packages.
modules.interfaces: Execute() runs root command. SetVersion(v) sets version. Exports Config types for YAML parsing. Uses analyzer and mcp packages.

submodules.name: root
submodules.description: Root cobra command with global flags (--path, --log-level, --version)

submodules.name: watch
submodules.description: Watch mode - monitors file changes continuously, updates index on change. Handles graceful shutdown via SIGINT/SIGTERM.
submodules.interfaces: watchCmd with --config, --skip-scan flags. Calls analyzer.NewWatcher, analyzer.NewAnalyser, analyzer.PrintBanner. Sets up signal handling.

submodules.name: scan
submodules.description: Scan mode - analyzes all files once, updates index, then exits
submodules.interfaces: scanCmd with --config flag. Same flow as watch but calls watcher.Flush() and exits

submodules.name: mcp
submodules.description: MCP mode - starts stdio JSON-RPC server for AI agents to query index
submodules.interfaces: mcpCmd. Validates index exists, calls mcp.Serve(workDir)

submodules.name: config
submodules.description: Configuration types and loading from YAML file with defaults. Supports .gitignore pattern merging.

submodules.name: common
submodules.description: Shared utilities: index initialization, config setup
submodules.interfaces: initIndex(indexDir) creates .memo/index/*.json, mcp.json, .gitignore. loadConfigAndSetup() loads config and sets log level

internal.relationships: root → watch/scan/mcp commands → config + common utilities → analyzer/mcp packages

modules.name: analyzer
modules.description: Core analysis engine. Watches filesystem with fsnotify, invokes AI via kimi-agent-sdk, validates JSON output against schemas. Includes status management, locking, and startup banner.
modules.interfaces: NewAnalyser(AgentConfig, workDir), Analyse(ctx, files). NewWatcher(root, ignore, debounce, maxWait, onChange), ScanAll(), Flush(), Run(), Close(). ValidateIndex(indexDir). TryLock/Unlock. SetStatus/GetStatus. PrintBanner(opts).

submodules.name: analyser
submodules.description: AI-powered analysis using kimi-agent-sdk. Batches files by directory (max 100), sends prompts, validates output with retry loop (max 5 attempts).
submodules.interfaces: NewAnalyser(), Analyse(), analyseBatch(), runPrompt(), splitIntoBatches(), toRelativePaths(). Uses embedded prompts/*.md

submodules.name: watcher
submodules.description: Filesystem watcher using fsnotify. Debounce/max-wait batching, concurrent analysis guard via semaphore. Robust error handling with describePathError() for broken symlinks and permission issues.
submodules.interfaces: NewWatcher(), ScanAll(), Flush(), Run(), Close(), add(), ignored(), describePathError(), watchAll()

submodules.name: validator
submodules.description: JSON schema validation for .memo/index files using gojsonschema. Embedded schemas for arch, interface, stories, issues.
submodules.interfaces: ValidateIndex(indexDir) → ValidationResult, FormatValidationErrors(). schemas map contains JSON Schema definitions.

submodules.name: lock
submodules.description: Single-instance lock using flock (Unix) or LockFileEx (Windows). Platform-specific via build tags.
submodules.interfaces: TryLock(memoDir) → *os.File, Unlock(f). Writes PID to lock file.

submodules.name: status
submodules.interfaces: SetStatus(memoDir, status), GetStatus(memoDir) → Status. Status has 'idle' or 'analyzing' with optional 'since' timestamp.

submodules.name: banner
submodules.description: Startup banner with ASCII art, version, greeting, update notice. Adapts to terminal width (full/compact/minimal).
submodules.interfaces: PrintBanner(BannerOptions). BannerOptions has WorkDir, Version, UpdateInfo. Helper: runeWidth(), truncatePath(), getGreeting()

submodules.name: export_testing
submodules.description: Exports internal functions for external test packages. Only compiled with -tags testing.
submodules.interfaces: Exports: GenerateSessionID, ToRelativePaths, SplitIntoBatches, LoadPrompt, GetGreeting, RuneWidth, TruncatePath

internal.relationships: watcher detects changes → analyser processes batches → validator checks output. lock ensures single instance. status signals progress to MCP. banner displays on startup.

modules.name: mcp
modules.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. Exposes .memo/index via JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio. Tools: memo_list_keys, memo_get_value with bracket-notation path parsing.
modules.interfaces: Serve(workDir) starts server. NewServer(workDir), Run(), Close(). ListKeys(indexDir, path), GetValue(indexDir, path). ParsePath(path) parses [file][key][index] notation.

submodules.name: server
submodules.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 server handling initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, tools/call methods. Logs to .memo/.history. Returns stale-data warning if analysis in progress.
submodules.interfaces: NewServer(), Run(), Close(), handleRequest(), handleToolCall(), tools() returns tool definitions with whenToUse guidance, getStatus()

submodules.name: query
submodules.description: Path parser and query executor. State machine for bracket notation with escape support, validates against allowed files whitelist.
submodules.interfaces: ParsePath(path) → file, segments, err. ListKeys(), GetValue(). traverse() navigates JSON. validateKey() checks length and control chars.

submodules.name: export_testing
submodules.description: Exports internal methods for external test packages. Only compiled with -tags testing.

internal.relationships: server receives JSON-RPC → dispatches to query functions → returns results. Checks status.json for stale-data warnings.

modules.name: internal
modules.description: Shared utilities package. Logging with 4 levels (error/warning/info/debug), LineBuffer for streaming output, HistoryLogger for debugging, auto-update checker.
modules.interfaces: SetLogLevel(), LogError/LogWarning/LogInfo/LogDebug(). NewLineBuffer(timeout), Write(), Flush(). NewHistoryLogger(memoDir, source), Log(), Close(). CheckUpdate(version), CheckUpdateAsync(version).

submodules.name: log
submodules.description: Logging with 4 levels (error=0, warning=1, info=2, debug=3). Global historyLog integration. LineBuffer for clean streaming output.
submodules.interfaces: SetLogLevel(), LogError/LogWarning/LogInfo/LogDebug(). InitHistoryLogger(), CloseHistoryLogger(). NewLineBuffer(), Write(), Flush(force)

submodules.name: history
submodules.description: HistoryLogger writes JSONL to .memo/.history for debugging. Thread-safe with mutex and sequence numbers.
submodules.interfaces: NewHistoryLogger(memoDir, source), Log(entry), LogError/Info/Debug(), Close(). HistoryEntry struct with Seq, Timestamp, Source, Type, etc.

submodules.name: updater
submodules.description: Auto-update checker via GitHub API. Async check with 2s timeout, semver comparison. Platform-aware install commands.
submodules.interfaces: CheckUpdate(currentVersion), CheckUpdateAsync(version). Returns UpdateInfo with LatestVersion, UpdateCommand. getUpdateCommand() detects homebrew/scoop.

internal.relationships: log uses history for persistent logging. updater is standalone, called from cmd/watch and cmd/scan.

relationships:
main → cmd.Execute() → watch/scan/mcp commands.

Watch/Scan mode: cmd → analyzer.Watcher → analyzer.Analyser → kimi-agent-sdk → .memo/index/*.json

MCP mode: cmd → mcp.Serve() → mcp.Server → mcp.query → .memo/index/*.json

Shared: internal/log, internal/history used by all packages. internal/updater used by cmd.

```mermaid
graph TD
    main --> cmd
    cmd --> watch[cmd/watch]
    cmd --> scan[cmd/scan]
    cmd --> mcpcmd[cmd/mcp]
    watch --> analyzer
    scan --> analyzer
    mcpcmd --> mcp
    analyzer --> internal
    mcp --> internal
```
